title: Two sets of justice, and a song
summary: He complains the business has two sets of everything for blacks and whites and breaks into singing.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: This business is a mess when I think about it -- the more I think about it the messier it is. Two sets of justice, two sets
of -- what do you call it? Lordy, two sets of everything. Two sets of society. Two of everything -- two rights and two wrongs. Never heard of such a thing. (Singing:)
"But that's the way she goes, boy, That's the way she goes That's the way she goes, boy, That's the way she goes."
"Love will find a way With bucks, with bucks, with bucks No matter what you say Ba-ba-de-da ----"
"We made a promise and sealed it with a kiss In a little Spanish town 'Twas on a night like this"
"We made a promise and sealed it with a kiss In a little Spanish town It was on a night like this On a night like this, on a night like this On a night like this"
